ResearchProjectDef.label: Blaster conqueror
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a conqueror mechanoid armed with a powerful charge blaster. Conquerors link their systems with nearby allied conquerors, improving their effectiveness in groups.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Carabine conqueror
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a conqueror mechanoid armed with a highly powered charge carbine. Conquerors link their systems with nearby allied conquerors, improving their effectiveness in groups.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Frostivus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a mobile cryogenic chamber mechanoid that stores, freezes, and dispenses organic material. It can also seal a targeted pawn inside itself for later use.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Gazer emplacement
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a reinforced fixed laser emplacement around a salvaged gazer ocular emitter. When manually aimed within its frontal firing arc, it releases a devastating sun ray beam at extreme power cost.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Haze
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a toxic area-denial mechanoid that can pump tox gas into the area around it. Its melee attacks inflict toxic buildup on targets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Lasher
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a plasma-whip mechanoid designed to handle, tame, and train animals. Its whip also functions in short-range combat, damaging and electrifying nearby targets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Pulse
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build an urban warfare mechanoid designed to breach structures and blind nearby enemies with intense impulse discharges. An installed jump pack lets it quickly move to its next target.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Tinker
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a support mechanoid that repairs same-faction buildings and mechanoids. It cannot construct new structures, but can shield allies and blind enemies with a targeted laser.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Vassal
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a coordination mechanoid that boosts nearby allies and extends mechanitor command range. Player-controlled vassals can also interface with local comms systems to improve allied morale.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Spitter conqueror
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a conqueror mechanoid armed with a powerful charge spitter. Conquerors link their systems with nearby allied conquerors, improving their effectiveness in groups.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Purifier station
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a pollution reclaimer that cleans pollution from a large area and vaporizes toxic wastepacks. Its drastic operation can cause severe ecological side effects.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mech gestator amplifier
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a facility that increases the gestation speed of adjacent mech gestators.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mech repair station
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a powered station that repairs small and medium mechanoids. The mechanoid enters the station to undergo repairs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mechanoid stasis chamber
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a specialized stasis chamber that stores mechanoids in suspended animation. Stored mechs consume no power and do not occupy mechanitor bandwidth.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Plasma whip
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a plasma whip inspired by the Lasher mechanoid's weapon. It can damage and stun multiple targets at once, making it useful for holding back enemies at close range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Advanced mech repair station
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a powered station that repairs large mechanoids. The mechanoid enters the station to undergo repairs.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Aegis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a mighty defensive mechanoid that sacrifices offensive capability for mastery of protection through its dual shields.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Celerus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a swift archotech commander mechanoid that can blink across short distances and create smokescreens that hide it from enemy perception.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Dominus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build an archotech commander mechanoid that empowers nearby allies and challenges perceived threats in psychic duels.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Dominion psy-spear
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a dominion psy-spear, a psionic weapon derived from Dominus control matrices.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Dynamo
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a mechanoid powered by an oversized internal reactor. It can anchor itself to a power grid and act as a mobile shield generator.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Gazer
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a heavy ocular-beam mechanoid that locks itself in place to fire a devastating sun ray and can discharge shockwaves at close range.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ingestor
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a battlefield scavenger mechanoid that finishes off survivors and refines organic material, including corpses, into chemfuel within its chassis.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Javelin
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a mobile missile-launcher mechanoid with switchable warheads, including armor-piercing, incendiary, high-explosive, and EMP rockets.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mantis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a blade-armed assault mechanoid that lunges into close combat and executes brutal slashing attacks.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Maul
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a heavily armored mechanoid designed to crush infantry, light vehicles, and outer defenses while overclocking its weapon under fire.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Ravager
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a heavy artillery mechanoid that can overcharge its weapon to launch devastating starfall barrages.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Terminus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build an archotech commander mechanoid that cleaves through groups, overdrives its combat systems, and drags distant enemies into reach with a grappling hook.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Severing blade
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a heavy combat blade integrated with Terminus-derived control matrices, allowing the wielder to channel sweeping psychic strikes.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Solus
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a reinforced gamma-ray emitter that produces a dense, destructive energy ball which discharges into nearby targets and ignites its surroundings.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Siren
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a psychic mechanoid that lures colonists toward itself. When controlled by a mechanitor, it can provide a mood and recreation boost to nearby allies.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Skipblade
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a skipblade, a compact psyflux weapon derived from Celerus displacement technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mechmancer suit
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechmancer suit and matching helmet, power-assisted mechanitor armor that greatly expands bandwidth while providing serious protection.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Mechmancer pack
ResearchProjectDef.description: Manufacture a mechmancer pack, an advanced bandwidth-expansion utility pack that can deploy independent satellite mechanoids.
